registration_response: Full native v2 envelope; data.id, data.harness, data.session, data.proc, data.binding (created/same). No legacy existing boolean or unwrapped JSON. Pull has data.pane=null and native_extension_delivery=false.
inbox_response: Full v2 envelope, data array of claims with job_id and message. Finite empty wait returns data:[]; no timedOut/self wrapper. Rendering must complete before ack. Self-send remains refused.

ambient.copilot: COPILOT_AGENT_SESSION_ID, UUID, with matching HOME/.copilot/session-state/<id> directory
ambient.codex: CODEX_THREAD_ID, UUID, with readable matching HOME/.codex/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-<date>-<id>.jsonl; retain session_meta cwd in fixtures
ambient.all: TMUX and TMUX_PANE absent/empty; HOME isolated; PIJ_SESSION_ID absent or stale is repaired only after native evidence is admitted. Do not manufacture PIJ_SESSION_ID or use FsRegistry/FsChannel. Separate conversations need distinct host processes.

host_evidence.rule: Public CLI executes as a descendant of a live matching external harness host. The wrapper submits its own process tuple; daemon observes ancestry, verifies incarnations, and returns/stores HOST tuple, never wrapper PID.
host_evidence.node_rule: Actual executable and argv[0] must be node, argv[1] the matching package entry. An active private IPC-capable fixture host at that package-shaped script path can spawn actual CLI children; copied argv[0], shell -c text, npm launcher or node -e is not host evidence. Explicit native session argv must agree.
host_evidence.proof_ceiling: A deterministic protocol host is not a real model canary. No provider calls or credential lookup are required or permitted by this fixture.

daemon.binary: Explicit worktree-local target/debug/pij-rs, honoring CARGO_TARGET_DIR when set; PM builds it. Never ambient production PATH binary.
daemon.readiness: Observe listening banner and authenticated /health; key is private-state/daemon.key. Zero port may be selected by OS and actual banner address propagated to clients.
daemon.isolation: No default7461, production binary/config/daemon, or transport logs. Own and wait for all child exits on teardown; no fixed sleep as readiness or delivery proof.

cross_slice_api: None added: smoke and remaining caller tests consume public CLI only. Helpers above are existing production evidence patterns, not new shared test dependencies.
